note: Landing-page slice of HighGround model outputs. Depth frames are for drawing; the numbers printed on the page come from 'street' and 'route' (the app's own street and parking records).
ground_cm: int16 little-endian, cm, row 0 = south, n*n
frames_cm: uint8 per frame, n*n, same layout

buildings.note: height from OSM building:levels or height where mapped, else a 2-4 storey drawing default

route.rule: closed to cars at 20 cm, decks stay open (the app's car navigation limit)
